data.text:
June update: I was busy building my iOS app, and after 5 rejections, it's finally live on the App Store. 🥳

This month, my focus shifts from building to marketing.

I'll be creating content for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube - starting with Instagram first.

I haven't been posting consistently over the last few months, but I'm planning to share more updates this month and stay consistent.

Let's see where this journey goes. 🚀
